elements.requirement: Except for section 21, the provisions of the National Minimum Wage Act 1998 apply to employment as a relevant member of the House of Lords staff in the same manner as they apply to other employment.
elements.quote: Apart from section 21 above, the provisions of this Act have effect in relation to employment as a relevant member of the House of Lords staff as they have effect in relation to other employment.

elements.requirement: No rule of law or Parliamentary law or practice prevents a relevant member of the House of Lords staff from bringing any claim under the National Minimum Wage Act 1998 before the High Court or the county court.
elements.quote: Nothing in any rule of law or the law or practice of Parliament prevents a relevant member of the House of Lords staff from bringing before the High Court or the county court any claim under this Act.

elements.requirement: A relevant member of the House of Lords staff is defined as any person who is employed under a worker’s contract with the Corporate Officer of the House of Lords.
elements.quote: “relevant member of the House of Lords staff” means any person who is employed under a worker’s contract with the Corporate Officer of the House of Lords.
